description: Deterministic ownership declarations for evolooption framework and template. Each domain declares its ownership scope, contact, and canonical source for runtime-agnostic agentic assets.

agentic-ai:canonical.description: Canonical upstream source of shared, runtime-neutral agentic-AI semantics. Owns the foundation bundle, principles, and playbooks that every runtime adapter projects from.

evolooption:domain.description: Domain-agnostic framework and starter template maintained by the evolooption project. Owns the Python package, steward manifest, template seed, and runtime adapters.

protected_surface.note: These paths must never be modified by the evolution loop; declared for ProtectedSurface enforcement.

user:domain.description: Consumer project domain. Consuming repos replace stub entries in template/.agentic/manifest.json with user:domain ownership and add their own agents, commands, skills, and eval suites.

validation.note: Every manifest entry (.agentic/manifest.json) must declare an owner from one of the domains above. Scripts/ai_assets.py check validates this invariant.
